description: Find the FactLot URN for an ID from another system, e.g. system "sdat_account" (a Maryland SDAT account number), "hcad_account" (a Harris CAD account number), "nyc_bbl" (a New York City borough-block-lot), "la_ain" (a Los Angeles County Assessor ID number), "sf_parcel", "boston_pid", "denver_schednum" or "ct_cama_link". registry_coverage lists the systems a registry holds. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

system.description: Crosswalk system name, e.g. "sdat_account" (Maryland), "hcad_account" (Harris County, Texas) or "nyc_bbl" (New York City).

name: registry_resolve_external
title: Resolve an external ID
